name: Exp_i-SpectrAnalysis_Chaikin
summary: This EA trades based on the i-SpectrAnalysis_Chaikin custom indicator, which applies spectral (Fourier) analysis to the Chaikin Oscillator. It opens buy positions when the spectrally-filtered Chaikin value turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable position closing on signal reversal.
summary_zh: 该EA基于i-SpectrAnalysis_Chaikin自定义指标进行交易，该指标对蔡金震荡指标应用频谱（傅里叶）分析进行滤波处理。当滤波后的蔡金值向上转折时开多仓，向下转折时开空仓，并可在信号反转时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于对蔡金震荡指标（Chaikin Oscillator）进行频谱分析滤波，去除高频噪声后提取主要趋势转折信号。入场条件：当滤波后的指标值从前一根到当前一根上升（Value[0]>=Value[1]）且前一根低于再前一根（Value[1]<Value[2]，即底部转折）时开多仓；当滤波后的指标值下降且前一根高于再前一根（顶部转折）时开空仓。出场条件：当信号反转时平仓——多仓在指标从上升转为下降时平仓，空仓在指标从下降转为上升时平仓，同时设有固定的止损和止盈。仓位管理支持多种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后余额比例、按亏损后自由保证金比例，以及固定手数模式。频谱分析通过N参数控制傅里叶变换的幂次（2^N个数据点），SS参数控制平滑程度，从而在去噪和信号延迟之间取得平衡。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on applying spectral (Fourier) analysis filtering to the Chaikin Oscillator, removing high-frequency noise to extract major trend reversal signals. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the filtered indicator value rises from the previous bar to the current bar (Value[0]>=Value[1]) and the previous bar was below the bar before it (Value[1]<Value[2], indicating a bottom reversal); a sell position opens when the filtered value declines and a top reversal pattern forms. Exit conditions: positions close on signal reversal — long positions close when the indicator turns from rising to falling, and short positions close when it turns from falling to rising, with additional fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing supports multiple modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage after loss adjustments, and fixed lot size. The spectral analysis is controlled by parameter N (power of 2 for Fourier transform data points) and SS (smoothing strength), balancing noise removal against signal lag.

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（自由保证金/余额/固定手数等）
parameters.description_en: Margin mode: free margin/balance/drawdown free margin/drawdown balance/fixed lot

parameters.description_en: Volume type: tick volume or real volume

parameters.description: 用于获取交易信号的K线索引

pros: 频谱分析滤波有效去除市场噪声，信号质量优于原始蔡金震荡指标
支持多种仓位管理模式，灵活适应不同风险偏好
可分别控制开仓和平仓方向，策略配置灵活度高
设有止损止盈，风险可控
使用新K线检测避免重复信号，减少过度交易
pros_en: Spectral analysis filtering effectively removes market noise, producing higher quality signals than the raw Chaikin Oscillator
Supports multiple position sizing modes, flexibly adapting to different risk preferences
Separate controls for opening and closing in each direction provide high configuration flexibility
Stop-loss and take-profit are implemented, keeping risk manageable
New bar detection prevents duplicate signals and reduces overtrading
cons: 频谱分析引入信号延迟，可能导致入场滞后错过最佳价位
止损设为1000点过大，在多数品种上可能造成较大亏损
缺乏加仓和减仓逻辑，仓位管理较为简单
没有考虑点差和交易成本对频繁信号的影响
依赖自定义指标i-SpectrAnalysis_Chaikin，若指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
cons_en: Spectral analysis introduces signal lag, potentially causing late entries that miss optimal price levels
Stop-loss of 1000 points is excessively large and may result in significant losses on most instruments
No scaling in/out logic; position management is relatively simplistic
Does not account for spread and transaction costs impact on frequent signal generation
Depends on the custom indicator i-SpectrAnalysis_Chaikin; if the indicator file is missing the EA fails to initialize
improvements: 增加自适应止损机制，根据ATR或波动率动态调整止损距离
添加点差过滤和交易时间过滤，避免在高成本时段交易
improvements_en: Add adaptive stop-loss based on ATR or volatility to dynamically adjust the stop distance instead of using a fixed 1000-point value
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid trading during high-cost periods

risk_points: 固定止损1000点过大，单笔亏损可能占账户较大比例
没有检查是否已有同方向持仓，可能重复开仓
频谱分析的平滑参数SS设置不当可能导致信号严重滞后或失真
risk_points_en: Fixed 1000-point stop-loss is excessively large; a single losing trade could represent a significant portion of the account
No check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially leading to duplicate position opening
Improper SS smoothing parameter may cause severe signal lag or distortion in spectral analysis
